lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Can you clear me for a ship out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Only if you're proven. They all say they are. Show me.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: You show the registrar Dizana's quiver.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Huh. Real Colosseum work. Not a market copy.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You're in the ledger now. The crews won't argue with the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: It's the first entry I've enjoyed all week.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ink doesn't lift, iknami. You're written for good.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Every day's long. The ships keep coming in.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Can you clear me for a ship out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No. I clear the proven, and you're not on my list.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: What counts as proven?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Come back wearing something the Colosseum gave you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No captain wants that risk. I just keep the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I made one once. I'd rather not discuss it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They all say that. Some of them are.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Minimus, can you get me a ship out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ships? I'm no sailor. What's that on your back, though?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: You show Minimus Dizana's quiver.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Twelve waves, and Sol Heredit face down. That's not luck.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My word carries at the docks. Tell them the Master sent you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They will. I've never had to say a thing twice.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The kingdom gave me this role. Word came with it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't thank me. Thank the twelve waves.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Minimus, can you get me a ship out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Me? I run an arena, not a harbour.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: So there's nothing you can do?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not for a Rookie. Prove yourself in my sand first.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Twelve waves. Come out the other side. Simple enough.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then the sea's not for you. Neither is my arena.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Everyone thinks about it. Fewer of them come back.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I want passage overseas. Who signs for that?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Queen's ledger does. Have you anything worth entering?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: You show the steward Dizana's quiver.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A quiver off the sand. I've not written one this season.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The crews read champions' names. Yours will get you aboard.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Your name, the wave, and the day. Nothing more.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: She reads the ones that matter. Yours might be one.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Come back with a better story than most.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I want passage overseas. Who signs for that?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nobody signs for an empty name. Mine is a champions' ledger.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: So how do I get a name?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Through that gate. Twelve waves. Then I'll dip my pen.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nobody. The captains want a name they've heard of.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: It is. That's rather the point of the thing.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They mostly don't. I'll leave the line empty.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Curator, I need a ship out of Varlamore. Can you vouch?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Vouching is not my trade, iknami. Authenticating is. Show me.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: You show Curator Herminius Dizana's quiver.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Indeed. Arena-made, and worn hard. This came off the sand.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I'll write to the harbour. My hand is known there.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No. A replica, though a very honest one.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Half the labels in this museum are in my hand.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not a problem, iknami. Do come back and read something.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Curator, I need a ship out of Varlamore. Can you vouch?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: For what, exactly? I authenticate objects. People are not objects.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Anything that proves I can look after myself.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then bring me something the Colosseum gave you. Nothing else counts.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A quiver from the sand. I would know it at once.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I could. Then my word would be worth rather less.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not a problem, iknami. The museum keeps long hours.
